inputs.name: projectPath
inputs.description: Absolute path to the selected project root.

inputs.name: omitNonInteractiveHints
inputs.description: Optional. True when interactive control is enabled for the agent CLI running this prompt; gates the non-interactive run-mode section. Absent means false.

inputs.name: repositoryPath
inputs.description: Resolved repository identity hint for the selected project.

inputs.name: last30daysQuery
inputs.description: Topic, comparison string, competitor seed, or brief research framing entered by the user.

inputs.name: targetScopeMarkdown
inputs.description: Frontend-composed markdown scope block built from selected repositories and their access labels.

inputs.name: targetRepositories
inputs.description: Selected repositories and their access types.

inputs.name: targetRepositoriesSelectAll
inputs.description: Optional. True when the repository scope is the resolved select-all state; absent or false means an explicit list.

inputs.name: targetRepositoriesScopeAccess
inputs.description: Optional. Access of the resolved select-all scope: write or read. Present only when targetRepositoriesSelectAll is true.
